notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (analytics + agent product). Began on Hosted API for quick prototype; now evaluating Dedicated for predictable throughput and lower per-token costs during peak inference. POC scope: 3-week Dedicated trial in staging, canary + fallback routing, validation of latency SLOs, and rollback drills.

Requirements / constraints:
- Workloads: user-facing chat + background reranking + embeddings for search. Heavy long-context sessions (avg 1.2k tokens).
- Performance targets: p95 latency <= 150ms for chat (short responses), sustained throughput 80-120 qps during business hours; burst to 250 qps for nightly batch reranks.
- Cost sensitivity: target reduce per-token cost by 30-45% vs hosted during sustained traffic.
- Security: must support SSO/SAML, KMS integration, audit logs retention 90d, data residency US-only. VPC peering required; on-prem not required.
- Model preferences: prefer open 7B/13B variants (quantized) for cost-first path; fallback to smaller low-latency model for extreme load. Also want optional Llama2-70B evaluation for high-quality reranking offline.

POC plan (agreed on 2026-02-18 demo):
- Phase 0 (prep): provisioning of Dedicated staging pool (4 GPU equiv) + network peering schedule. Install test harness and metric collectors. (Owner: Frostline infra, SE Leo supporting)
- Phase 1 (smoke): run synthetic traffic, validate correctness, KV/prefix caching works, measure p50/p95/p99.
- Phase 2 (canary): route 10% production-like traffic from Hosted -> Dedicated pool for 72 hours. Monitor: latency, tail, error rate, token cost, and quality regression on eval set.
- Phase 3 (ramp): if canary OK, ramp to 50% for 48 hrs, then 100% for a second validation window.
- Fallback / routing policy: primary route -> Dedicated (preferred model: catalyst-13b-qtz); fallback chain -> hosted:catalyst-7b-llama-quantized, then hosted:safe-lite (smaller). Region failover: us-east primary, us-west secondary. Automatic failover on instance health or congestion (thresholds: queue length > 500ms or error rate > 0.5%).
- Rollback playbook: immediate rollback to Hosted default model via routing policy toggle; notify SRE/AE; run postmortem. Practice rollback during canary dry-run.

Metrics & validation criteria:
- Quality: no more than 2% negative delta in reranking NDCG on canonical eval set during canary.
- Latency: p95 <= 150ms (chat short), p99 < 350ms.
- Cost: targeted 30% lower per-token cost for sustained traffic compared to hosted baseline.

Open items / blockers:
- Legal: standard Dedicated addendum redlines outstanding (security appendix) — on legal review.
- Network: VPC peering available next maintenance window (tentative 2026-03-18).
- Finance: need committed capacity approval for 6-12 month discount band.

Quotes / call snippets:
- "Hosted got us started fast, but we need predictable billing for the agent product." — Frostline CTO
- "We want a dry-run of the rollback; don't want surprises during canary." — Product lead

Artifacts: pricing deck + security Q&A (links above). Jira RED-1127 opened for quota/invoice questions. Next meeting: 2026-03-12 to align on peering window and finalize canary schedule (AE Aisha, SE Leo, Frostline infra).
